notes.title: Hotfix v1.0.1 is live!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

If you’re new to the game or returning after a while and find that the new experience this game brings is still a bit overwhelming, then I think this update is for you. I’ve been keeping an eye on the community as I always do so that I can get an understanding of how players feel and make necessary adjustments to help improve the player experience.

So, in this update, I focused on difficulty balance for training and easy modes for both new and casual players as well as a few quality-of-life changes and increases to XP gain/Astral Shards to help players level up faster for a more rewarding experience.
[h2]
UPDATES[/h2]
[list]
[*] The movement speed of Wrath’s mimic books during hunts has been reduced on all modes and will despawn quicker on Easy and Training Mode. In addition, the damage from Mimic’s has been reduced by 25% on easy mode and 50% on Training mode.
[*] The chance of possession from Gluttony Hallucinations during hunts has been reduced on Easy and Training mode.
[*] The Ghost has had its movement speed slightly reduced on all Difficulties.
[*] The movement speak while the Entity is awakened (Corruption is 100) has been reduced on Easy and Training mode. Please keep in mind that the intended mechanic of Corruption is that players find HIDING spots where they are completely immune to death and cannot be detected. Players can then crouch around the map which makes it extremely hard for the entity to hear them while they look for corruption mass to burn. 
[*] The player detection radius of awakened entities to both see and hear players has been reduced on Easy and Training Mode to help provide new/casual players with a higher window of reaction opportunity. 
[*] Possession Resistance is now easier even at low Sanity levels on Easy and Training mode.
[*] Sanity Damage taken from Possession has been reduced by 50% on Training Mode and 15% on Easy. This should help players survive much more easily while learning how to survive the possession.
[*] XP gain and Astral Shard reward from quests has been increased roughly 25% to help with player progression at early levels.
[*] Bonus XP and Astral Shard reward from completing all 3 quests on turn in has been increased. 
[*] The Quest “Breaking the Ice” now displays the current progress of Fire Pits the player has lit at the right side of the screen.
[*] The Quest “The Learning Curve” will now display the “Story Quest Complete” message” at the top middle of the player's screen and the story menu will properly reflect the status as completed.  
[*] The radius at which the TIP message should display on Hallucinations for players has been increased so that new players don’t need to get as close to and feel at risk of possession while reading.
[*] One of the Jumping puzzles for Office Research was known to be on the difficult side, so I’ve adjusted the platforming there to have much easier leap points to get to the objective.
[*] Setting your FPS Limit no longer requires a client restart to apply.
[/list]

[h3]Thanks everyone, I hope this improvement helps!
Halo[/h3]

notes.title: Update 0.0.9 is here! More Horror, More Investigation, New Features, and more!
notes.notes:
[h2]What's New[/h2]
[list]
[*] [h3]Hunt Maps[/h3] In this update I have completely changed the way we hunt entities. Now, we must enter their dimensions to hunt them! What does this mean? There are 3 new incredible maps that you will enter through a portal to the entity’s dimension once a Level 3 energy has been absorbed once. 
[olist]
[*] [b]Demon [/b]- Demonic Cultist Chapel
[*] [b]Ghost [/b]- Gothic Graveyard
[*] [b]Witch [/b]- Medieval Village in the Woods 
[/olist]
[*] [h3]Redesigned Deduction System[/h3]All entities now start off with 4 abilities (1 ability of each entity type). When hunting the entity will randomly select 1 of 4 abilities to use and will try to prioritize its “TRUE” ability more often than the others. Players can either challenges themselves or make it easier to determine the entity by permanently removing abilities from the entity until only the “TRUE” ability is left by finding and activating what is known as [b]"Embodiment Marks"[/b]. 
[*] [h3]Embodiments [/h3]Each dungeon has 3 methods of spawning an Embodiment Mark. 
[olist]
[*] [b]Mark 1[/b] – Events: Paranormal Events are the NEW HORROR system in On Dark Terms. Ghost events come in different forms such as a projector that turns on in the Office or a carousel that turns on in the Amusement Park.  When this happens, it’s possible that an Embodiment Mark will spawn if players get close enough to it and will need to investigate to see if they can find it. Marks can be activated by taking an image of them with your Video Camera which will remove an ability from the entity making it easier to deduce during the hunt. 
[*] [b]Mark 2[/b] – Interactions: this new fun mechanic adds more observation to the game, requiring players to pay attention to objects that have been moved/relocated in the dungeon. For example, you might notice that one of the crochet teddy bears in the Amusement Park has moved. You will want to check the bear's body to see if there is a mark drawn on its back. If so, you can take a photo of it to activate the Embodiment and remove and ability from the entity. 
[*] [b]Mark 3[/b] – Anomalies: anomalies are a replacement for the “Trait System”. When activity level (which has been renamed to [b]"Corruption Level"[/b]) reaches 100, an anomaly will spawn that can only be seen in your Video Camera for an anomaly that can only be seen in the camera. For example, if you see a small Witch’s Table in your camera but not in the real world, you have found the anomaly and will need to take a picture of it! Taking a picture of the anomaly permanently reveals the object in the real world for everyone to see. You can then activate the sigil that is on it to remove an ability from the entity.  
[*] [b]Embodiments Deduction[/b] – it’s important to know that embodiments have more purpose than just finding marks to help reduce the number of FALSE abilities the entity has. Embodiments are special traits that can grant the entity with different passive perks if players choose to activate the Embodiment associated with them! So, it’s a tradeoff. Activating a mark will reduce the number of abilities making it easier to deduce the entity, however, this will also grant the entity with a passive perk based on which Embodiment that mark belongs to.
[/olist]
The player has choices now while investigating. How much do you wish to challenge yourself when entering hunts! Do you think you can figure out which ability the entity uses the most while it is using 4 different abilities or do you need a little more help and wish to search for embodiment sigils to reduce the number of FALSE abilities. That decision is completely up to you!
[*][h3]Hiding![/h3]
Each dungeon now has designated hiding spots that players can jump into to stay safe from the entity when it awakens, spirits when activating the spirit charm, and even mimics when using the summon circle.
[/list]
[h2]UPDATES[/h2]
[list]
[*]Map Size Reduction and visual updates! All maps have been revisited when it comes to floor plan. After hearing player feedback when it comes to favorite dungeons and map layouts, I’ve decided to update the maps so that each map feels similar in size but still completely different in atmosphere and layout. Hopefully all players, whether alone or with friends, will now find that all dungeons feel great. This was also possible by moving hunts into their own maps which removes the imbalance issue of certain entities feeling impossible in certain maps while others feel too easy.  
[*]Activity– has been renamed to “Corruption” and can no longer be reduced by burning corruption. Instead, Corruption increases overtime until reaching 100 upon which it will Awaken the Entity and Spawns a corruption mass that players can burn. Burning corruption ends the awakening and resets the Corruption Level to zero.  
[*]Awakening – now occurs when the Corruption Level reaches 100. The entity will now kill players it reaches instead of possessing them if they do not jump into a hiding spot in time! Burning corruption ends the awakening.
[*] Awakening no longer kicks players out of Astral Form.
[*] Reaching zero Stamina no longer kicks the player out of Astral Form.
[*]Death – Energy is no longer lost on death for any difficulty! This will remove the burden of dread when dying then needing to repeat the spirit charm and summon circle all over again especially when it’s only the hunt that players are trying to survive.
[*]Attuning – players can no longer select the Entity Type outside the dungeon, attune and then tell other players the answer. Now, players need to select their entity type while inside the dungeon! The drop down for selecting the entity you think it is has been added to the new Database UI.
[*]Database – the “Astral Core” tab has been removed and merged with the database. The database now contains tabs to simplify and separate reading for core topics such as “Deduction, Entity, and Embodiments”. Additionally, the deduction section has been updated to show players what their next main objective is based on which energy they’ve absorbed.  
[*] Player movement keys "WASD" is now mappable in the keybinds UI to help with accessibility.
[*]All items are now properly held while crouching (only the camera could be seen previously)
[*]Training Mode objectives (required for “Complete Your First Dungeon” quest) will now update progress depending on which energy was absorbed. For example, if your group member spawns Level 2 energy and you absorb it before you get Level 1 energy, then when you go to get your Level 1, the system will recognize that level 2 is also absorbed and jump your objective progress to level 3 energy objective (assuming you don’t already have that one too). This will address issues that new players experienced while attempting to complete objectives at a different pace than their group members. 
[*]The Train Station Map has been raised above ground so that players can run beneath it making it much easier to navigate to maps such as the Mall.
[*] The Mansion has been moved closer to the center of the world map.
[*]Demon Hunts now have 3 monks for 1-2 player group size and 4 monks for 3-4 player group size.
[*]Players no longer take damage when interacting with the The Offering.
[*]Hallucinations will no longer spawn on Training Mode until at least ONE energy has been absorbed. This will allow new players to have more time in the beginning to read and get familiar with the environment without worrying about threats right away.

notes.title: Update 0.0.8 is here! The Biggest Update so far. Dungeon reworked and more!
notes.notes:

[list]
[*] The dungeon entrance and astral shrine have been merged. Players must now interact with the Astral Shrine to start / end dungeons AND attune. No more back and forth travel to end a dungeon then attune. This makes it a lot easier and more intuitive when finishing up a dungeon run.

[*] Attuning Energy now auto-clears the database for the player.

[*] The Astral Shrine Entity Dropdown now displays only the Sub-Types for the entity the player is Attuning for instead of a list of all entities in the game.

[*] All Research Sites have been completely updated visually to appear as if built into the dungeons themselves for a more immersive look as part of the Open World Update on its way.

[*] The Player Guide has been updated to reflect the new Dungeon Design and now provides video clips for every step of deduction, providing players with a full understanding of how to perform their tasks.

[*] [b]Astral Form[/b]:
[olist]
[*] "Meow" emote can now be used while lying down.
[*] Small cat footstep sound effects have been added in.
[*] Sprint now degenerates stamina much more slowly.
[*] Crouch is now a mechanic used to move undetected around Spirit Charm entities.
[/olist]
[*] [b]Dungeon Design[/b]: revisited to have a more riveting and intuitive flow that removes the “waiting game” feeling from features like level 3 energy and makes Hunts feel more end-game: 

[olist]
[*] Evidence in the game has been cut from 8 to 4 (black mold, fingerprints, vocalization, and writing removed).
[*] Energy Levels have been changed to Level 1, 2, 3, and 4 with newly adjusted mechanics for obtaining them.
[*] Level 1 Energy: using Astral Form, the player must search for Dark Matter the same they would have in the 0.0.7 and previous builds. No change here.
[*] Level 2 Energy UPDATE: what used to be the “second” Level 1 is now Level 2. Dark Matter Level 2 will only spawn if players use a spirit charm. Spirit charms don’t spawn until a player absorbs Level 1 Energy at least once per dungeon run. Transmuting Dark Matter Level 2 will immediately end the Spirit Charm and spawn evidence as it did in 0.0.7 and previous builds.  
[*] Level 3 Energy UPDATE: surviving a hunt no longer grants a level 2 dark matter. Instead, players must use a Summoning Circle. Successfully completing the Summoning Circle Ritual by finding the correct Book of Rituals and speaking to it, instantly spawns a level 3 Energy that can be absorbed. 
[*] Level 4 Energy NEW: reaching level 100 activity no longer grants level 3 dark matter. Instead, surviving a hunt AFTER at least one person has absorbed a Level 3 Energy, will instantly spawn a Level 4 energy at the location the entity was last seen. This simulates “Loot” from an RPG boss fight.
[/olist]
[*] [b]Dark Matter[/b]:
[olist]
[*] now displays its Level in the name text so that players can more easily distinguish between them.
[*] deals sanity and stamina damage to all players when transmuted. Scaled based on difficulty.
[/olist]
[*] [b]Observed Energy[/b]:
[olist]
[*] now displays its Level in the name text so that players can more easily distinguish between them.
[*] deals sanity and stamina damage only to the player that absorbed it. Scaled based on difficulty.
[/olist]
[*] [b]Hallucination[/b]:
[olist]
[*] can now be killed without the use of an Adrenaline Pen!
[*] now spawns based on how high the Activity level is rather than how low the player's sanity is.
[/olist]
[*] [b]Flash Hunt[/b]: chance to spawn won't incur until the player has absorbed a level 2,3, or 4 energy.

[*] [b]Adrenaline[/b]:
[olist]
[*] now lasts 10 seconds down from 20 seconds.
[*] No longer prevents hallucinations from spawning.
[/olist]
[*] The Spirit Charm and The Summoning Circle now lock the Dungeon Entrance for their duration or until all players die just like The Offering does for Hunt.

[*] [b]Spirit Charm[/b]:
[olist]
[*] Will now spawn only after at least one player has absorbed a level 1 energy. 
[*] Now has a 2.5 second cast time down from 3.5 seconds and only a 1-minute cooldown down from 3 minutes. 
[*] Is now required to spawn Dark Matter Level 2 that can be transmuted. If players do not find and transmute the Dark Matter before the Spirit Charm deactivates, the Dark Matter will despawn and players will need to reactivate it. 
[*] Entities from the spirit charm can now see players in Astral Form and will kill them if reached! However, crouching while in Astral Form makes the player invisible to Spirit Charm Entities and immediately stops them from pursuing their target upon entry. Speed of spirit entities is increased per difficulty.
[*] A new cast bar at the top of the screen has been added to indicate visually to the player how long they have before the Spirit charm ends. The time the player has is now scaled based on the number of players in the group at the activation of the Spirit Charm.
[/olist]
[*] [b]The Summoning Circle[/b]:
[olist]
[*] Will now spawn only after the trait has been disturbed.
[*] Mimics in the Dark Realm no longer kill players on contact, but instead deal damage to Sanity on contact by an amount that scales with Difficulty. 
[*] Now has a 2.5 second cast time down from 3.5 seconds and only a 1-minute cooldown down from 3 minutes.
[*] Is now required to obtain Level 3 energy.
[*] Spirit Box is no longer required to speak with the “Book of Rituals”. Holding V is all that’s required to get a reaction.
[*] A new cast bar at the top of the screen has been added to indicate visually to the player how long they have before the Summoning Circle ends. The time the player has is now scaled based on the number of players in the group at the activation of the Summoning Circle.
[/olist]
[*] [b]The Offering[/b]:
[olist]

[/olist]
[*] [b]Activity[/b]:
[olist]
[*] Reaching 100 activity level no longer increases the difficulty of hunts. Instead, 100 Activity level causes the entity to permanently awaken. On Normal and Hard Mode difficulties, the entity will kill the player if it reaches them rather than possessing.
[*] Activity level is now the only factor that increases the difficulty in resisting possession. 
[/olist]
[*] [b]Sanity[/b]:
[olist]
[*] Sanity no longer passively reduces while inside a Dungeon as it is a mechanic that doesn’t fit well with RPG principles. Sanity will be reduced directly from various game mechanics such as entity abilities, possessions, and more.
[*] Reaching Zero sanity will now kill the player.  
[/olist]
[*] [b]Possession[/b]:
[olist]
[*] Now lasts 2.5 seconds down from 4 seconds but will last longer scaled by activity level up to a maximum of 1.5 additional seconds.
[*] Getting possessed by the entity or hallucinations reduces sanity every second scaled based on difficulty.
[/olist]
[*] Random hunts are no longer a mechanic for any difficulty. Hunts must always be invoked using “The Offering”.

[*] Disturbing the trait no longer invokes a hunt on any difficulty.

[*] [b]Corruption[/b]:
[olist]
[*] The value that activity level decreases by has been increased for all difficulties to accommodate the new corruption burning mechanic. 
[*] Each time corruption is burned, a stacking effect that lasts the duration of the dungeon will apply to the entity, enhancing its initial hunt speed. The amount of movement speed increased per burn is scaled by difficulty. Training Mode=1%, Easy Mode=2.5%, Normal Mode=5%, Hard Mode=10%. 
[*] Burning corruption deals 25 sanity and stamina to everyone in the group and scales based on difficulty.
[/olist]
[*] The Spirit Box has been removed as it no longer serves any purpose in the game with the removal of vocalization and writing evidence.

[*] All Hunts on Normal and Hard Mode Difficulty have had the passive movement speed increase based on number of players in the group reduced by 25%.

[*] [b]Progression[/b]: this update brings a more RPG leveling approach to the game design, giving players more to look to forward as they progress into higher levels.
[olist]
[*] Reaching Level 15 now increases XP required to level up from 1000 to 1500. Reaching Level 40 now increases XP required to level up from 1500 to 2000 (Max Level cap coming soon). This gives more incentive to do normal mode rather than Easy Mode to level up and unlock rewards. Players can still level 1-50 on easy mode, but it will take longer compared to doing Normal.
[*] Normal Mode is now locked behind Character Level 15 in addition to the existing Research level requirement.
[*] Hard Mode is now locked behind Character Level 40 in addition to the existing Research level requirement.
[*] Players will only earn the bonus XP gained from Normal / Hard Modes if they have that mode unlocked themselves. Players are still able to enter modes they don’t have unlocked via another player’s level, but they will not reap the bonus rewards from it.
[/olist]
[*] [b]Performance and Optimization[/b]: A new graphics option to Enable / Disable Nanite has been added to help with platforms that do not support it and/or low-end PCs that are not recommended to run Nanite. Unreal specifies that players enable nanite if they have:
[olist]
[*] NVIDIA: Maxwell-generation cards or newer (RTX)
[*] AMD: GCN-generation cards or newer
[*] All newer version of Windows 10 / Windows 11 with support for DirectX 12
[*] Latest Graphics Drivers
[/olist]
If your PC does not meet these requirements, disable Nanite in game to get the best experience. 
[/list]

[h2]FIXES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where dropping inventory items was only granting 1 item instead of the intended amount.

[*] Fixed an issue with shadows that was occurring when players were joining sessions where the host’s in-game time was Nighttime.

[*] Fixed an issue where resurrecting from the dead was causing the player’s camera to inconsistently face the intended direction, which was to be in the direction of the Dungeon Entrance.

[*] Fixed an issue where exiting Astral form was not re-equipping the recent item the player had out before entering Astral Form.

[*] Fixed an issue with ectoplasm where if 2 were overlapping, it was extremely difficult to get the correct one.

[*] Fixed an issue where the reward icons for level 36 and 45 were flipped.

[*] Fixed some spawn point issues for dark matter and hunts.

[*] Fixed some environmental imperfections.

[*] Fixed some grammatical issues.

[/list]

[h2]What’s Next? 0.0.9![/h2]
0.0.9 is planned to revisit all Entity Abilities. This update will bring a new look and feel to gameplay when it comes to crossing paths with entities both during hunts and not during them. Balancing will also be revisited for all entities during this time. There will also be some changes to the “Hunt” UI as well as the new Astral Shrine UI to incorporate Difficulty differences so that players can easily see what to expect as they choose between difficulties.
0.0.9 will also target to further enhance player progression and give players more incentive to do different dungeons meaning that there be significant reasons to do one dungeon over another.

notes.title: Update 0.0.5 is here!
notes.notes:
It's been tough trying to push updates for both existing players and new players while simultaneously interacting with the community, implementing high priority features such as key binds, and fixing bugs, but I have been doing my very best to make this game a better version of itself with each update by keeping the player's experience and feedback in mind. 

I hope that this update will finally get new players to no longer feel overwhelmed while starting out.

[h2]UPDATES[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b] NEW Dungeon Item [/b] – The Offering: The Offering is a new item that can be used in dungeons to instantly invoke a hunt. The Offering requires the blood of players to be activated. When a player finishes the cast, all players in the group will lose sanity and stamina scaled by the Dungeon difficulty.

[*] [b]Hunt Update: [/b] Hunts now occur based on difficulty. E.g., Hunts no longer randomly occur on Training and Easy Mode.  This will allow new players to not have to worry about being interrupted randomly during their process of gathering energy while still getting used to the game. Hunts will only randomly occur on Normal Mode once a trait has been disturbed. Hunts can randomly occur at any time the moment the dungeon starts on Hard Mode.

[*] [b]Activity Update: [/b] On Training and Easy Mode, Activity Level now pauses at 30 until a trait is disturbed upon which it will then continue to increase to 100. On Normal and Hard Mode, Activity Level does not pause and will increase until it reaches 100. 

[*] [b]Awaken Update: [/b] Awaken has been disabled on Training Mode except for when the trait is spawned after burning a corruption with 2 Level 1 energies Absorbed (since it is required to see the entity for certain traits). This will further help reduce the “overwhelming” new player experience so players can focus more on the objectives rather than the survival. 

[*] [b]Corruption Update: [/b] Corruption will no longer spawn at the beginning of every dungeon. Instead, Corruption will only begin to spawn after a minimum of 1 player has Absorbed 2 different level 1 energies. This not only adds more depth to dungeon progression and the feeling of “the darkness growing’ but it also allows new players to focus more on finding and transmuting dark matter rather than getting distracted by Corruption and burning it with no idea as to what it does or why they are doing it. The idea is to make the flow of dungeons more intuitive, and progression driven. This will make it easier for new players to focus on learning without so many things to read and interact with.

[*] [b]Progression Update: [/b] Surviving Hunts doesn’t currently feel as rewarding as it should, so in this update, surviving a hunt now ties into the level progression. XP granted from Disturbing the trait has been reduced, but surviving a hunt will grant additional XP to make up for the reduction in trait XP. This provides greater dungeon progression, and it makes surviving a hunt feel much more rewarding.

[*] The story introduction has been simplified by removing a few steps that required players to peek at the astral core and database which seemed like a good idea in theory but appears to overwhelm players more than it helps them learn. These UIs are very important for players to understand later as they are the main source of deduction and have been integrated into the dungeon in a more intuitive manner. This should help lighten the “info dump” players feel when they haven’t even entered a dungeon yet. Again, the goal creates a more intuitive flow that keeps the player focused without being hit with information they don’t need to know about yet. 

[*] Disturbing the trait no longer immediately invokes a hunt on Training and Easy Mode. Disturbing the trait will still immediately invoke hunts on Normal and Hard modes.

[*] The trait timer has been updated to scale based on difficulty modes. For example, the Trait Timer for Training Dungeon is now 3 minutes up from the previous 1.5 minutes, allowing new players ample time to focus more on finding the trait rather than worrying about the timer.

[*] Removed some message popups in the training mode that seemed to clutter and/or confuse players more than help them.

[*] Removed the spirit charm and the summoning circle from the Training Dungeon as I have noticed from feedback and watching players, that these items only confuse players more than it helps. These items will spawn on Easy Mode and Higher and can still always be read about by pressing “Y” when next to them. The idea is to simplify the number of interactable objects and information as much as possible for the new players so that they are not so easily distracted and can focus on learning.

[*] Removed the post process effect from corruption that was making the screen darker when near it.
[/list]

[h2]FIXES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where trait timers weren't properly synced if players walked out of dungeons then back in while a timer was active.
[/list]

Thank you everyone for continuing to play, posting feedback, being kind, and supporting me as I continue to improve this game!

Hard Mode – stamina loss for being wrong increase movement speed per correct sigil plus correct sigils damage all players sanity and stamina by 30.

[*] [b]Revenant Ghost Update[/b]: the Revenant had its ability nerfed and now scales based on difficulty.

[*] [b]Wraith Ghost Update 1[/b]: wraith ability has been nerfed so that players now have more time to survive its reap attack based on difficulty. The harder the difficulty, the less time to hide before his reap attack goes off.

[/list]

[h2]FIXES[/h2]

[*] Fixed more spelling errors.

notes.title: Update 0.0.3 is here!
notes.notes:
[h2]Update 0.0.3 is here![/h2]
This update brings some more love to the new player experience, bug fixes, and some balancing issues with demons (don’t worry, ghost and witch updates are brewing).

[h2]THE NEW PLAYER EXPERIENCE[/h2]
[list]
[*] Trait update! I know a lot of players, especially new players, have trouble understanding what exactly they are looking for when it comes to finding traits. So, I’ve added pictures into the trait tooltip when hovering over their names so you can now know what they look like! I hope this will help a ton!
[*] The introduction story to the thermos evidence was a bit tricky for many. So, I’ve created a new location for it that should be much more intuitive to find.
[*] Thermo Gun UPDATE! The thermos gun laser point now detects the exact point of cold source meaning that as your laser point gets further from the source, the readings get larger, as you get closer, the readings get lower. This new update matches the intuition players have when following the laser pointer assuming it will lead to the source. New players should find this new thermos much easier to use!
[*] Spirit box UPDATE! Currently, players must speak into the spirit box TWICE (once for a light to turn on, a second to an evidence), but guess what, not anymore! I found this “speak twice” mechanic confusing players more than it was helping them and decided to remove it. Now, the very first response to the player’s voice will spawn writing or vocalization!
[/list]

[h2]PROGRESSION[/h2]
[list]
[*] Normal mode no longer grants a flat 50% XP increase. Instead, Energy XP increases individually based on Normal Mode and getting the ghost correct grants additional XP based on normal mode as well. For example: Energy Level 1 grants 100 XP if a trait is disturbed on Easy Mode, but grants 125 XP if a trait is disturb on Normal.
[/list]

[h2]UPDATES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Demon Update 1: teleport time has been nerfed for all group sizes to help control the chaos and now additionally scales based on dungeon difficulty.  This increase should provide better windows of escape for larger groups that are trying to play for the first time.
[*] Demon Update 2: teleport location was frustrating lots of players due to the demon appearing in the middle of the circle, so guess what? The demon will no longer teleport to the center of the circle! I hope this helps you guys survive a little bit better, especially the new players.
[*] Wrath demon mechanic was not properly implemented and now has a new ability: “When a Wrath demon begins using its ability it becomes one of the most dangerous entities of all, empowering the forces of the Darkness causing Flash Hunts to automatically kill players if reached during a HUNT. However, if encountered on Hard Mode difficulty, flash hunts will automatically kill both during and not during hunts.”

[*] Flash hunts have been updated to incorporate difficulty scaling as follows: Training -10 Sanity, Easy -20 Sanity, Normal -50 Sanity, Hard -90 Sanity.
[*] Flash hunts no longer perform a camera shake when reaching the target to help distinguish between what a successful flash is and what a failed flash is.
[*] Energy drinks now replenish 40% of their effect when fatigued up from 25%.
[*] The world map has minor coloring updates to help differentiate between important points of interest such as dungeons vs research location names.
[/list]

[h2]FIXES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed some areas where players could escape the map.
[*] Fixed the Mansion doors stuck in a wall that was not supposed to be there which was affecting the entity’s navigation paths.
[*] Fixed an issue where players that switched to cat form while falling from a high distance would be teleported to either somewhere below the map, under a building, or some other location they weren’t supposed to be.
[*] Fixed an issue where some ghost hunt coffins and sigils in the library were obstructed.
[*] Fixed an issue where retriggering dark matter for vocalization and writing would instantly despawn an existing vocalization or writing.
[*] Fixed an issue where research objectives at the research site computers were not reflecting their progress as either completed or in-progress as seen in the player’s journal.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.0.2
notes.notes:
[h2]The Big Update is here![/h2]
So, let’s get into the details. As we know, On Dark Terms is full of complex mechanics and new concepts which naturally entails a lot of leaning for players. However, the learning process with respect to the Training Dungeon (Tutorial), was lacking and needed some love. So, for the past 2 days I’ve been non-stop watching and listening to all the feedback and thinking deeply about how I could make the game much more enjoyable for players starting off and so, here’s where I am at:

[h2]THE "NEW PLAYER" EXPERIENCE UPDATES[/h2]
[list]
[*] When a player burns a corruption after absorbing 2 level 1 energies, a NEW Trait Message will appear on the screen for 30 seconds telling the player the name of the Trait, what it looks like and how to disturb it. This message will only pop up for Training and Easy Modes.
[*]  When a trait despawns either on its own or by a player disturbing it, a NEW Trait Message will appear to inform all players.
[*] Now players will know exactly what trait they are looking for the moment they burn, making it much easier to learn the system. Remember Normal Mode and Hard Mode will disable this, so you need to do more investigation yourself on harder difficulties.
[*] When trying to use adrenaline or energy drinks with none left, players were informed with the message prompt “not enough” which is vague. It will now say “not enough adrenaline” etc.
[*] The player action bar now displays “0” on consumables instead of nothing to better indicate how many the player has.
[*] The Astral Shrine now displays a message on it that informs the player that they are required to have a minimum of 1 absorbed energy in order to Attune and earn XP. Prior to this, players didn’t know what they needed.
[*] Burning corruption has easily been probably one of the most frustrating things as it would always awaken the entity and cause players to get constantly chased and possessed. This new update changes the mechanics so that burning corruption will ONLY awaken the entity after 2 energies have been absorbed and the trait has yet to be disturbed. Once disturbed, burning will return to its normal behavior which is lowering activity without worrying about an awakening. So now you can burn, burn, burn away til your hearts content.
[*] I noticed that lots of you were getting hunted almost immediately after starting and entering a new dungeon and it’s unacceptable especially for players who literally just walked in for the first time. This update adds a hunt delay based on difficulty level. Hunts won’t start on training until 2 minutes have passed giving new players more room to focus on learning without being instantly hit with a complex mechanic.
[*] Added a NEW message for when players hit the wrong sequence item in a hunt so that you can clearly know that what you did was wrong rather than wondering if it was right or not. 
[*] So, I saw lots of people struggling to coordinate the sigils during hunts and realized, especially for new players, that it was greatly complicating the learning experience and so we now have all NEW NAMES for every single sigil! Example: The Moon, The Eye, The Staff, etc. This will make coordination and remembering the sigils during hunts so much easier!!
[*] Energy Drinks regarding Fatigue (I heard those of you who were saying “but why can’t I drink while fatigued, isn’t that the point when you’re tired?”). The Energy Drink has been updated so that it now clears fatigue rather than being prevented by it. However, if used while fatigued, it will only provide 25% of its stamina gain.
[*] Added additional location names to the world map to help find certain areas for research objects such as the skate park and diner, etc., more easily.
[*] Interactable items can now be read about in any dungeon using the (“Y” key). Some people may not have read about spirit charms while in training, now they can be read about in any dungeon. 
[*] The message tip at the TOP right of training has been updated to always show the player their training objectives. Lots of players were unsure where to view their objectives let own track them. The tip also encourages you to check the player guide which provides a step by step walk through of how to complete all 3 training objectives.
[*] The hunt message has been updated to say: “You are being hunted!” to the left of the current hunt progress message to help indicate especially to new players that they are experiencing a hunt.
Consumables are now infinitely usable during training mode to help players survive better so they can focus on learning.
[*] A NEW message will be displayed on players screens when they complete all 3 training objectives to let them know that they are finished with the training story quest.
[*] A NEW message will display when you die informing you that all your energy has been lost. I noticed most people didn’t realize losing energy on death was a thing.
[/list]

[h2]Research[/h2]
[list]
[*] Research Sites now have “Hunt Computers” you can access to read about how hunts work so you don’t have to run back to the train station.
[*] Research objectives now only show “in-progress” if they are actually picked up at that location.
[*] Increased the radius of research objectives so that their indicator is easier to find so players have an idea of what to climb when they see it.
[/list]

[h2]PROGRESSION[/h2]
[list]
[*] Completing research now additionally grants 200 player XP to help player’s level up faster.
[*] Completing research now levels up research site immediately rather than granting 700 XP.
[*] Story quests now grant 800 XP up from 600 XP.
[*] Crafting now grants 5 XP per item crafted, providing more incentive for players to craft.
[*] Getting the entity correct now grants 150 XP.
[/list]

[h2]UPDATES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Stamina uptime increased by 30% while in Astral Form to help searching for Dark Matter easier especially in slightly larger maps.
[*] Increased player movement speed inside dungeons by 10% to help with moving around / slightly larger maps.
[*] Increased the radius of ectoplasm detection in Astral Form to make finding them easier.
[*] Increased the distance at which orbs can be seen in the video camera.
[/list]

[h2]FIXES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Attuning energy at the amusement park was always showing “Envy” demon as the answer. This was actually affecting multiple areas and now attuning should always provide the expected answer of the entity type.
[*] Fixed an issue where players could die if possessed just as they walked outside which would completely break their player camera and force them to restart the game.
[*] Fixed an issue where players could enter an existing hunt from outside while alive.
[*] Fixed an issue where stamina was not regenerating sometimes for players.
[*] Fixed an issue where when leaving the dungeon as cat, the world map would get stuck on the “No Signal” screen. 
[*] Fixed a collision issue were using astral form while standing on vehicles clipped the player through them.
[*] Fixed the research objective at the skatepark with the lengthy description as its nameplate.
[*] and many other smaller bugs and hiccups!
[/list]

[h2]THANK YOU[/h2]
As always, thank you to everyone who supported me! I hope that this update helps a lot, especially for players that haven’t played yet. I will continue to work hard as there are still many things on my list and I will do my best to get them all rolled out and polished up!

[h3]P.S. there is a little thank you the next time you login - as a token of my appreciation.
[/h3]
